issues: Revision note says the in-trial cardiovascular composite hazard ratio was replaced with proportions from the retained source, but Section 3.1 still presents HR 0.84 and 0.87, an unresolved internal contradiction.
The total-slope contrast (0.75 mL/min/1.73 m2/yr, 95% CI 0.54–0.96) appears in the results without a bonded claim marker in the evidence matrix, as the delivery's own notes acknowledge.
judge.rationale: Thoroughly answers the brief: declares design, searches, eligibility, unregistered protocol; keeps three EMPA-KIDNEY reports as one primary study; excludes the guideline from counts; clearly distinguishes randomized treatment from observational post-trial follow-up. Core EMPA-KIDNEY numbers are consistent and appropriately caveated. Minor deductions for a stale revision-note contradiction and one unbonded numeric estimate; safety framing is cautious and evidence-level-appropriate.
